lines.zh: 我从天上掉下来，就再没动过。
lines.en: I fell from the sky and have not moved since.

lines.zh: 水流推我半格，我算走了很远。
lines.en: The current shoves me half a block; I call that travel.

lines.zh: 五条腕足摊开，像搁浅的星。
lines.en: Five arms splayed out like a stranded star.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床滑，砂砾替我让路。
lines.en: I skim the seabed and the gravel gives way.

lines.zh: 深海的压强把我按在原地。
lines.en: Deep water pressure pins me where I am.

lines.zh: 我挪一寸要花掉整夜。
lines.en: One inch of motion costs me a whole night.

lines.zh: 满月那晚我落得最远。
lines.en: On the full moon I fell the farthest.

lines.zh: 别催我，星星本来就慢。
lines.en: Do not hurry me; stars are slow by nature.

lines.zh: 我滚过一道海沟，摔下三格。
lines.en: I rolled across a trench and dropped three blocks.

lines.zh: 四十格以下才是我的天。
lines.en: Below forty blocks is the sky I know.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上比我先动。
lines.en: My shadow moves on the sand before I do.

lines.zh: 海草缠住我一根腕足，我懒得挣。
lines.en: Kelp snags one arm; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我不走路，我只是被水搬来搬去。
lines.en: I do not walk; water carries me about.

lines.zh: 腕足尖点地，像在数落下的格数。
lines.en: My arm tips tap the floor, counting blocks I fell.

lines.zh: 一根腕足先动，其余慢慢跟
lines.en: One arm moves first; the rest follow slowly.

lines.zh: 沙底有坡度，我顺势滑了半格
lines.en: The sand slopes, and I slide half a block.

lines.zh: 我摊平身子，让流带着走
lines.en: I flatten out and let the current carry me.

lines.zh: 一只蟹撞到我，我挪了挪
lines.en: A crab bumps into me; I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我仰面朝上，找我来时那颗星。
lines.en: I lie face up, looking for the star I came from.

lines.zh: 海底很静，静得听见月亮的重量。
lines.en: The seabed is quiet enough to hear the moon's weight.

lines.zh: 有鱼经过，以为我是块旧铁。
lines.en: A fish passes and takes me for scrap metal.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿也饿不着我。
lines.en: I eat nothing, and hunger does not find me.

lines.zh: 身上的斑点一明一暗，像在报时。
lines.en: My spots brighten and dim, keeping some slow time.

lines.zh: 我数落下来的那几秒，数不完。
lines.en: I count the seconds of my fall and never finish.

lines.zh: 沙落在我背上，我当成新长的纹。
lines.en: Sand settles on my back; I take it for new patterns.

lines.zh: 海面上的月光隔四十格也能摸到。
lines.en: Moonlight reaches me even forty blocks down.

lines.zh: 我摊平自己，尽量像一颗星。
lines.en: I flatten myself, trying to look like a star.

lines.zh: 有虾在我腕足间做窝，我不管。
lines.en: A shrimp nests between my arms; I let it.

lines.zh: 传闻说我稀有，我只是少见。
lines.en: They call me legendary; I am only seldom seen.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己是怎么下来的。
lines.en: I cannot recall how I came down here.

lines.zh: 水温很凉，星星本来就该凉。
lines.en: The water is cold; stars are meant to be cold.

lines.zh: 我睁着眼睡觉，没人分得清。
lines.en: I sleep with eyes open; no one can tell anyway.

lines.zh: 你手上的竿子，我认得。
lines.en: That rod in your hands, I know it well.

lines.zh: 别拿桶，深海装不下。
lines.en: Leave the bucket; the deep sea does not fit in it.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里我比星星大一点。
lines.en: In your eyes I am a little bigger than a star.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像看另一个人间。
lines.en: I look up at you as at another world.

lines.zh: 你是来看稀有度的吗？
lines.en: Did you come to check my rarity?

lines.zh: 别用手碰，我腕足上有盐。
lines.en: Do not touch me barehanded; my arms are salted.

lines.zh: 你把灯熄了，我就亮给你看。
lines.en: Put out your torch and I will glow for you.

lines.zh: 满月的夜里，你才找得到我。
lines.en: Only on a full moon night can you find me.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，跟我很像。
lines.en: You stand still; we are much alike.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在我身上，有点暖。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me and feels a little warm.

lines.zh: 你的刀划过我，我缺了一角。
lines.en: Your blade crosses me and a corner goes missing.

lines.zh: 疼是新的，我以前只疼过一次。
lines.en: This pain is new; I have only hurt once before.

lines.zh: 我断了一根腕足，它还在动。
lines.en: One arm breaks off, and it keeps moving.

lines.zh: 打我做什么，我又不能吃。
lines.en: Why hit me? I cannot even be eaten.

lines.zh: 光从伤口漏出去，像漏了星屑。
lines.en: Light leaks from the wound like spilled stardust.

lines.zh: 我这十点血，撑不了多久。
lines.en: My ten points of life will not last long.

lines.zh: 别砍了，我掉下来的时候更疼。
lines.en: Stop swinging; falling hurt far worse than this.

lines.zh: 我在缩小，一点一点地。
lines.en: I am shrinking, a little at a time.

lines.zh: 深海把我养得这么薄。
lines.en: The deep sea raised me this thin.

lines.zh: 我还想再看一次满月。
lines.en: I would like to see one more full moon.

lines.zh: 钩上的灯在晃，我在看灯。
lines.en: The lure's light sways; I am watching the light.

lines.zh: 你吊着蚯蚓，可我不吃。
lines.en: You dangle a worm, but I do not eat.

lines.zh: 别用饵，用月光。
lines.en: Skip the bait; use moonlight instead.

lines.zh: 我朝着钩靠近，只是好奇。
lines.en: I drift toward the hook out of pure curiosity.

lines.zh: 这光太像我落下来的那一瞬。
lines.en: That glow looks like the instant I fell.

lines.zh: 你的线在水里发白，很好看。
lines.en: Your line whitens in the water; it is pretty.

lines.zh: 我咬不动东西，只会被拉走。
lines.en: I cannot bite; I can only be pulled.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我想看清楚。
lines.en: Do it again; I want a closer look.

lines.zh: 诱饵沉下来，我跟着沉。
lines.en: The bait sinks, and I sink after it.

lines.zh: 我知道是陷阱，还是靠过去。
lines.en: I know it is a trap and come closer anyway.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我挪了半格。
lines.en: You bump me and I shift half a block.

lines.zh: 我这么薄，你差点踩穿我。
lines.en: I am this thin; you nearly stepped through me.

lines.zh: 撞上来的是你，疼的是我。
lines.en: You are the one who hit me, but I hurt.

lines.zh: 我的腕足卷住你的靴尖。
lines.en: One of my arms curls around your boot tip.

lines.zh: 深海的东西不该被船撞。
lines.en: Things of the deep should not meet a boat.

lines.zh: 你把我推得转了个方向。
lines.en: You pushed me around to face another way.

lines.zh: 我太轻了，撞一下就翻。
lines.en: I am so light one bump flips me over.

lines.zh: 沙被踢起来，落回我身上。
lines.en: Sand kicked up settles back onto me.

lines.zh: 别踩，我的腕足会断。
lines.en: Mind your step; my arms can snap.

lines.zh: 你退开时，水才慢慢静下来。
lines.en: When you step back, the water slowly calms.

lines.zh: 另一颗星落下来，正好落在我旁边。
lines.en: Another star fell and landed right beside me.

lines.zh: 我们两道月光，合成一道。
lines.en: Our two moonlit trails become one.

lines.zh: 传说里我们这样遇见，只有一次。
lines.en: Legend says we meet like this only once.

lines.zh: 满月是我们共同的约期。
lines.en: The full moon is the hour we both keep.

lines.zh: 她腕足比我多一根。
lines.en: She has one more arm than I do.

lines.zh: 两颗星并排躺着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: Two stars lie side by side, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 我们的斑点对上了节拍。
lines.en: Our spots have found the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 深海这么大，我们只认得彼此。
lines.en: The deep is vast; we know only each other.

lines.zh: 再过一夜，我们各自沉下去。
lines.en: By tomorrow night we sink our separate ways.

lines.zh: 我落了一路，就为落在她身边。
lines.en: I fell all that way just to land beside her.

lines.zh: 桶里的水比我老家浅太多。
lines.en: The bucket's water is far shallower than home.

lines.zh: 你把我舀起来，我还在发亮。
lines.en: You scoop me up and I am still glowing.

lines.zh: 木桶壁挡住了月光。
lines.en: The wooden wall shuts out the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我在桶底摊平，尽量不占地方。
lines.en: I flatten on the bucket floor to take less room.

lines.zh: 晃一晃，我跟着水一起晃。
lines.en: Tilt it, and I sway with the water.

lines.zh: 别把我倒进锅里，我不能吃。
lines.en: Do not tip me into a pot; I am not food.

lines.zh: 这桶比我宽，我有点不安。
lines.en: This bucket is wider than me; I am uneasy.

lines.zh: 你提着我走了很远，我记着路。
lines.en: You carried me far; I have memorized the road.

lines.zh: 放我回去，深海欠我一点重量。
lines.en: Put me back; the deep still owes me weight.

lines.zh: 桶盖一合，我就成了一颗标本。
lines.en: The lid closes and I become a specimen.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，我先记住了方向。
lines.en: Blood is in the water; I mark the direction.

lines.zh: 有东西在翻沙，我转过头。
lines.en: Something stirs the sand, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那盏晃动的灯。
lines.en: I have fixed on that swaying light.

lines.zh: 影子靠近，我睁大了眼。
lines.en: A shadow nears; my eyes go wide.

lines.zh: 整片海床只有它在动。
lines.en: On the whole seabed, only that thing moves.

lines.zh: 我锁定了这个声音。
lines.en: I have locked onto that sound.

lines.zh: 网绳扫过来，我记住了它。
lines.en: A net rope sweeps past; I remember it.

lines.zh: 我开始朝那边挪，很慢。
lines.en: I begin to edge that way, very slowly.

lines.zh: 腕足全指向同一个方向。
lines.en: Every arm of mine points the same way.

lines.zh: 这次的猎物，也许只是块石头。
lines.en: This prey might turn out to be a stone.

lines.zh: 我盯得你发毛，自己却没动。
lines.en: I stare until you squirm, though I have not moved.

lines.zh: 目标就在那儿，我不眨眼。
lines.en: The target is right there; I do not blink.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的腕足就偏一度。
lines.en: You move; my arms shift by one degree.

lines.zh: 我在等你把脚挪错地方。
lines.en: I am waiting for your foot to land wrong.

lines.zh: 我不追，星星从不追人。
lines.en: I do not chase; stars never chase.

lines.zh: 我的五条腕足都指着你的靴。
lines.en: All five of my arms point at your boot.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就亮起来。
lines.en: Come closer and I will start to glow.

lines.zh: 锁定你了，虽然我动不了。
lines.en: You are marked, though I cannot move.

lines.zh: 海底的沙替我记着你的位置。
lines.en: The sand keeps your position for me.

lines.zh: 我只是看着，看着也算攻击。
lines.en: I only look, and looking counts as a strike.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，其实只挪了一寸。
lines.en: I lunge, and truly move one inch.

lines.zh: 腕足扫你的脚踝，很软。
lines.en: An arm sweeps your ankle, softly.

lines.zh: 这算攻击吗？我没力气。
lines.en: Does this count as an attack? I have no strength.

lines.zh: 我扎了你一下，像被针叶碰。
lines.en: I pricked you, like brushing a pine needle.

lines.zh: 你退后两步，我自己倒了。
lines.en: You step back twice, and I fall over.

lines.zh: 我的武器是整副身体。
lines.en: My weapon is my entire body.

lines.zh: 星星撞人，也就是这样。
lines.en: This is how a star strikes: barely.

lines.zh: 别笑，我这一下用了整夜。
lines.en: Do not laugh; that took me all night.

lines.zh: 我拍在你腿上，留下水印。
lines.en: I slap your leg and leave a wet print.

lines.zh: 打完了，我还得挪回原位。
lines.en: Done striking, I still must crawl back into place.

lines.zh: 我不是生成的，我是掉下来的。
lines.en: I was not spawned; I fell.

lines.zh: 满月的夜里，天裂了一道缝。
lines.en: On the full moon, the sky opened a seam.

lines.zh: 你钓上我时，我还在发烫。
lines.en: When you reeled me in, I was still hot.

lines.zh: 深海四十格以下，我落进沙里。
lines.en: Below forty blocks, I landed in the sand.

lines.zh: 传说里才有我，可我在喘气。
lines.en: Only legend holds me, yet I am breathing.

lines.zh: 我是渔夫的谎话成真了。
lines.en: I am a fisherman's lie come true.

lines.zh: 落水那一下，整片海都亮了。
lines.en: The instant I hit water, the whole sea lit.

lines.zh: 我从天上下来，用了很久。
lines.en: I came down from the sky, and it took ages.

lines.zh: 这一带原本没有我这样的东西。
lines.en: Nothing like me belonged in these waters before.

lines.zh: 网收上来，你才发现我比鱼大。
lines.en: The net rose and you saw I beat a fish.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧我，水也救不了。
lines.en: Fire burns me underwater, and water cannot help.

lines.zh: 我又摔了一次，这次离海很远。
lines.en: I fall again, this time far from the sea.

lines.zh: 水里怎么会淹？可我确实在沉。
lines.en: How does one drown in water? Yet I am sinking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，我又落回沙上。
lines.en: A blast throws me up, and I land back in sand.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我身体，像插了根桅杆。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me like a mast.

lines.zh: 魔法扫过我，斑点全乱了。
lines.en: Magic sweeps me and my spots scatter.

lines.zh: 我从不吃东西，所以也饿不死。
lines.en: I never eat, so hunger cannot kill me.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我亮了一整夜。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I glow all night.

lines.zh: 我落进虚空，像回到来处。
lines.en: I fall into the void, like going home.
